Karthik / team — quick engineering summary: 
- Verified production error-rate spike: 2025-06-30T03:12:18Z → 2025-06-30T03:45:56Z (UTC). Root cause: control-plane routing hotpath entered a degraded state after a rare interplay of a canary rollout and an autoscaler jitter; this produced a cascading authz token renewal storm on a subset of hosts.
- Evidence attached: svc-traces-20250630.tgz (contains sampled traces), tidal_grafana_snapshot_20250630.png (endpoint heatmap), and a 2-page chronology in the tarball.
- We checked KV-cache logs: a sequence of evictions coincides with the spike on three hosts (node-azb-12/13/14).

Preliminary classification: qualifies as a partial downtime under sec 4.2. Our proposed remedy is a pro-rata credit for the 33m38s window. I ran a conservative calculation (see attached proposed-credit-calculation.xlsx) — the draft credit equals 12.7% of the monthly service fee for the affected tenant month, subject to final contract validation.

Proposed next steps:
1) Deliver the tarball and Grafana snapshot to Samir (we'll redact customer PII).
2) Legal review (Laura) to confirm credit formula is permitted under the contract.
3) Schedule a 60-minute postmortem with Tidal ops + Redwood infra (proposed Wed 07/02 or Thu 07/03).

I've uploaded the Grafana snapshot here: https://grafana.redwood.prod/snapshots/abcd-20250630 and created a support ticket SUP-2719 for trace extraction.

—Marcus
Principal SRE, Redwood Inference
